title: definitions
description: Values a runner substitutes for a jig's placeholders. One level of names and scalar values, the same shape whether it is a jig's own block or a file supplying them, so there is one thing to validate and one thing to read.

propertyNames.description: A placeholder's name, matching what {name} spells in a command. Underscored, because template variables are underscored where command-line flags are hyphenated.

additionalProperties.description: A literal. It carries no substitutions of its own, so reading the file settles it and nothing resolves in terms of anything else. Scalar because a list has no defined spelling on a command line. An empty string is a value; the absence of the key is not.
